# Star Health Comprehensive Insurance Policy

## 1. Initial Waiting Period
A waiting period of 30 days from the inception date of the policy applies for any hospitalization, except for emergency accidental bodily injuries.

## 2. Specific Disease Waiting Periods
A mandatory waiting period of 24 consecutive months of continuous coverage applies for specified diseases and surgical procedures, including Cataract, Benign Prostatic Hypertrophy, Hernia, Hydrocele, Hysterectomy, and Joint Replacement Surgeries (unless caused by accident).

## 3. Pre-Existing Diseases (PED) Waiting Period
Pre-existing conditions declared at the time of policy inception are subject to a 36-month waiting period of continuous coverage before claims are admissible.

## 4. Cashless Pre-Authorization Protocol
Planned hospitalization pre-authorization requests must be submitted to the hospital TPA desk at least 48 hours prior to admission. Emergency hospitalization requests must be notified within 24 hours of admission.

## 5. Room Rent and ICU Limits
For Sum Insured up to ₹5,00,000, normal room rent is capped at 1% of the Sum Insured per day. ICU charges are capped at 2% of the Sum Insured per day. For Sum Insured of ₹10,00,000 and above, single private standard air-conditioned room is permitted without proportionate deductions.

## 6. Claim Rejection & Appeal Procedure
Common reasons for rejection include non-disclosure of pre-existing diseases, claims within waiting periods, and unapproved experimental treatments. Written appeals must be submitted to the Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO) within 30 days of the rejection notice.
